entities.summary: Jacob Anthony Chansley, also known as Jake Angeli, QAnon Shaman, Q Shaman, and Yellowstone Wolf, is an American conspiracy theorist and convicted felon who participated in the January 6 United States Capitol attack, for which he pled guilty to obstructing an official proceeding. He is a former supporter of Donald Trump and a former believer and disseminator of the QAnon conspiracy theory.
